blocks.translation: 许多程序设计语言与模型都在处理硬件异构性。OpenMP 最初是同构程序设计模型，后来在 StarSs、OpenACC 等早期提案 [34, 31] 的基础上，增加了把任务和并行区域卸载到加速器的支持 [32]。C++ AMP、HCC 与 SyCL 利用传统 Clang/LLVM 流程和现代 C++，提供硬件加速的高层抽象 [46]。遗憾的是，这些方案都会很快把高层构造降低为对运行时执行环境的调用，再依赖宿主语言——通常是 C++——的既有优化来缓解抽象开销。真正针对异构编译过程本身的工作少得多。扩展 LLVM IR 的并行中间表示解决了部分问题，但传统上仍关注同构环境 [23, 42]。当时最具雄心的工作可能是 Liquid Metal [3]：它协同设计 DSL 与编译流程，把托管对象语义转换为静态、向量或可重构硬件；然而，其 Lime 编译器的大部分精力仍用于把“圆形对象塞进方形硬件”（转述 Kou 与 Palsberg [24]）。MLIR 通过可扩展 Op 与类型集合，为拥抱异构性的高级语言提供直接嵌入，并提供共同基础设施逐步降低这些构造，从而最大限度复用不同目标间的通用组件。

blocks.original_text: Tackling language heterogeneity has been a long-term promise of metaprogramming systems, and of multistage programming in particular. Lightweight Modular Staging (LMS) [39] is a state of the art framework and runtime code generator, providing a library of core components for generating efficient code and embedding DSLs in Scala. Delite [45] promises dramatic productivity improvements for DSL developers, while supporting parallel and heterogeneous execution. We believe this approach is complementary to MLIR, providing a higher-level of abstraction to embed DSLs and implement optimizations through generic metaprogramming constructs.
blocks.translation: 处理语言异构性，一直是元编程系统、尤其是多阶段编程的长期承诺。轻量级模块化分阶段（LMS）[39] 是先进框架与运行时代码生成器，提供核心组件库，用于生成高效代码并在 Scala 中嵌入 DSL。Delite [45] 在支持并行与异构执行的同时，承诺显著提高 DSL 开发者的生产率。作者认为，这类方法与 MLIR 互补：它提供更高抽象层次，通过通用元编程构造嵌入 DSL 并实现优化。

blocks.original_text: One step further up into the language syntax, ANTLR [33] is among a class of parser generators that aim to make it easy to develop a new compiler frontend. MLIR currently does not have a general parser generation, no AST construction or modeling functionality. Combining MLIR with a system such as ANTLR could result in reusable compiler libraries from user input through to code generation.
blocks.translation: 再向语言语法上层迈一步，ANTLR [33] 属于一类旨在简化新编译器前端开发的解析器生成器。MLIR 当时没有通用解析器生成能力，也没有 AST 构建或建模功能。把 MLIR 与 ANTLR 等系统结合，可能形成从用户输入一直覆盖到代码生成的可复用编译器程序库。

blocks.original_text: More narrowly construed by their application to machine learning, XLA [57], Glow [40] and TVM [11] address similar heterogeneous compilation objectives. Yet these are rather specific code generation instances starting from a graph abstraction and targeting multi-dimensional vector abstractions for accelerators. All of these could leverage MLIR as infrastructure, taking advantage of the common functionality while using their current code generation strategies. Similarly, the loop nest metaprogramming techniques from Halide [36] and TVM [11], earlier loop nest metaprogramming [19, 41, 5, 14], and fully automatic flows such as PolyMage [28], Tensor Comprehensions [52], Stripe [58], Diesel [16], Tiramisu [4] and their underlying polyhedral compilation techniques [17, 54, 8, 55] could co-exist as different code generation paths within an MLIR-based compilation framework. Serialization and interoperability formats, such as ONNX [48], have a different approach towards addressing the diversity of ML frontends by providing a common set of ops that different frameworks could map on to. ONNX would be a candidate as a dialect in MLIR to which other ops could be lowered to and from.
blocks.translation: 若把范围收窄到机器学习应用，XLA [57]、Glow [40] 和 TVM [11] 也处理类似的异构编译目标。不过，它们都是较为专门的代码生成实例，从图抽象出发，以加速器的多维向量抽象为目标。它们都可以把 MLIR 用作基础设施，在沿用现有代码生成策略的同时利用通用功能。类似地，Halide [36] 与 TVM [11] 的循环嵌套元编程技术、更早的循环嵌套元编程工作 [19, 41, 5, 14]，以及 PolyMage [28]、Tensor Comprehensions [52]、Stripe [58]、Diesel [16]、Tiramisu [4] 等全自动流程和底层多面体编译技术 [17, 54, 8, 55]，都可以作为不同代码生成路径共存于基于 MLIR 的编译框架中。ONNX [48] 等序列化与互操作格式采用另一种方法：提供一组不同框架都能映射到的共同 Op，以应对机器学习前端的多样性。ONNX 可成为 MLIR 中的一个方言，其他 Op 可以降低到该方言，也可以从中转换出来。

blocks.original_text: We presented MLIR, a flexible and extensible infrastructure for compiler construction. This paper described MLIR’s concrete design, demonstrated its applicability to a range of important domains, and described a number of original research and engineering implications.
blocks.translation: 本文介绍了 MLIR——一种灵活、可扩展的编译器构建基础设施。论文描述了 MLIR 的具体设计，展示它对一系列重要领域的适用性，并阐述了若干原创性的研究与工程影响。

blocks.original_text: Looking ahead, we are eager to see how established compiler communities (e.g. the Clang C and C++ compiler) as well domain experts can benefit from the introduction of higher level, language-specific IRs. We are also interested to see if MLIR enables new approaches to teaching the art of compiler and IR design, and hope to see entirely new areas of research catalyzed or accelerated by this infrastructure.
blocks.translation: 展望未来，作者期待看到成熟编译器社区——例如 Clang C/C++ 编译器社区——以及领域专家如何从高层、语言特定 IR 的引入中受益。作者也关心 MLIR 能否促成教授编译器与 IR 设计技艺的新方法，并希望这套基础设施催生或加速全新的研究领域。

blocks.original_text: **Future directions.** There are multiple future directions being pursued for MLIR. In the ML and HPC space, these include inferring efficient Op implementations from reference rank-polymorphic specifications with symbolic shapes. It also involves enabling a wider range of data structures (sparse, graphs) and program transformations, bringing together symbolic reasoning, such as automatic differentiation and algorithmic simplification, with more conventional data flow and control flow-based optimizations. Beyond ML and HPC, one may consider MLIR’s applicability to other related domains, such as secure compilation, safety-critical systems, data analytics and graph processing, relational query optimization, etc.
blocks.translation: **未来方向。** MLIR 正在推进多个未来方向。在机器学习与 HPC 领域，其中包括从带符号形状、对秩多态的参考规约推导高效 Op 实现；还包括支持更广泛的数据结构——如稀疏结构与图——和程序变换，把自动微分、算法化简等符号推理，与更传统的基于数据流和控制流的优化结合起来。除机器学习与 HPC 外，还可考察 MLIR 在安全编译、安全关键系统、数据分析与图处理、关系查询优化等领域的适用性。

blocks.original_text: Returning to the world of general-purpose languages, an obvious missing front-end is a C++ mid-level representation derived from Clang. Say, a “CIL” similar in spirit to Swift’s SIL and Rust’s MIR, that would facilitate the optimization of common C++ idioms that currently need to be reconstructed from lowered code (e.g., treating std::vector as an array rather than pointer manipulation). Supporting garbage-collected languages, higher-order and polymorphic type systems with type inference in MLIR are open challenges as well.
blocks.translation: 回到通用语言领域，一个明显缺失的前端是从 Clang 派生的 C++ 中层表示，例如一种在精神上类似 Swift SIL 和 Rust MIR 的“CIL”。它将有助于优化常见 C++ 惯用法；这些结构目前必须从降低后的代码中重建，例如把 std::vector 视为数组，而非一系列指针操作。让 MLIR 支持垃圾收集语言、高阶类型系统，以及带类型推断的多态类型系统，也都是开放挑战。

blocks.original_text: Exploring parallelism and concurrency constructs in LLVM has been difficult, primarily as the changes required are invasive and not easily layered (e.g., injecting metadata and inspecting all passes to ensure metadata is propagated while losing optimization opportunities as the level of abstraction is too low). With MLIR, parallel constructs can be first-class operations, using regions and parallel idiom-specific verification. This would support higher-level transformations before lowering to, e.g., LLVM where regular transformations can be performed on already lowered code.
blocks.translation: 在 LLVM 中探索并行与并发构造一直很困难，主要原因是所需修改具有侵入性，难以分层。例如，注入元数据后必须检查所有 Pass 以确保元数据得到传播；与此同时，抽象层次过低又会丧失优化机会。在 MLIR 中，并行构造可成为一等 Op，并使用区域和并行惯用法特定的验证。这样，在降低到 LLVM 等表示之前可以先执行高层变换，之后再对已降低代码执行常规变换。

blocks.original_text: Beyond debugging and testing, textual form of IR is also useful for education. Additional tooling to show the interaction of optimizations in high-performance compilation could demystify compilers for new students. IR design is an integral part of developing a new compiler or optimization framework, but many undergraduate compiler curricula do not cover IR design. MLIR provides opportunities for new approaches to such lessons that could be explored.
blocks.translation: 除调试与测试外，IR 的文本形式也有教育价值。若有额外工具展示高性能编译中各项优化如何交互，就能帮助初学者理解编译器，不再觉得它神秘。IR 设计是开发新编译器或优化框架不可分割的一部分，但许多本科编译器课程并不涉及 IR 设计。MLIR 为探索这类课程的新教学方式提供了机会。
